summary: Iteration 11 fully validated. Backend pytest 12/12 pass (test_iteration11.py): match_end_date accepted on POST /api/clubs/{id}/announcements and echoed; status computed from match_end_date correctly (upcoming when now<start, ongoing when start<=now<=end, past when now>end). serialize_announcement exposes match_end_date, can_rate, has_rated on both /matches/history and /clubs/{id}/announcements. can_rate is true ONLY when is_full=true AND status==past AND user is a real player AND at least 1 other real player exists AND user not in rated_by; verified false for a fresh non-participant. POST /api/announcements/{id}/rate: 403 for non-participant, ignores self-vote (julie->julie no-op) and unknown user_ids, applies ratings for co-players (marc's reliability_count +1 after julie's rate), then can_rate flips to false and has_rated to true for julie's subsequent history read. POST /api/announcements/{id}/replay accepts match_date+match_end_date and creates a new upcoming 4/4 match with the same team. Frontend E2E on /matches: auto-open of rate modal on load triggered (rate-confirm auto-opened, 3 co-players rate-player-<uid> chips with rate-<uid>-star-<n>), rating all 5-star and clicking rate-confirm makes the button disappear and shows 'Joueurs notés · merci !' — verified visually. Passés tab lists ONLY 4/4 matches (2 cards for marc, both with 4/4 chip). Club chat compose picker shows Date + Heure de début + Durée (compose-day-<i>, compose-hour-<h>, compose-dur-<mins>) with compose-endinfo recap ('Créneau : 19h → 20h'), and announced posts display the range (e.g. lun. 17 août · 19h20 → 20h20). Regressions OK: 4 seed logins (marc/julie/thomas/sophie), club price_per_hour, favorites, history. Only cosmetic RN Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*', pointerEvents) remain.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated; use 'boxShadow'. Cosmetic on native. Reference: multiple StyleSheet blocks (e.g. /app/frontend/app/matches.tsx:366, /app/frontend/app/club/[id].tsx:472,588).
Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents. Likely originates from a third-party overlay/Modal. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and switch pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (non-blocking; native unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:239-263 match_status(match_date, match_end_date) — defaults end to start+2h if match_end_date is missing (safe backward-compat). Uses timezone-aware UTC comparison; correctly returns upcoming/ongoing/past.
server.py:441-485 serialize_announcement exposes match_end_date + computes can_rate = is_full AND status=='past' AND is_real_member AND other_real>0 AND user not in rated_by — matches spec exactly.
server.py:614-633 POST /announcements/{id}/rate — 403 if user not in players; iterates ratings, skips self and non-players (r.user_id==user or not in players); marks user in rated_by (idempotent).

server.py:538-583 POST /announcements/{id}/replay — accepts match_date + match_end_date, clones players+offline_names, sends invite DM to co-players. New announcement's status is computed from provided end date (verified upcoming in tests).
matches.tsx:74-82 auto-open of rate modal on first load via autoOpenedRef sentinel — avoids re-opening on refocus. Sets group to 'past'.
matches.tsx:221-236 rate-match-<id> button rendered iff item.can_rate; ratedTag ('Joueurs notés · merci !') rendered iff item.has_rated && item.is_full — spec compliant.
matches.tsx:108-122 doRate builds ratings list from co-players only (filters self), uses api.rateMatch — spec compliant.
MatchDatePicker.tsx:56-60 commit() derives end = start + duration*60000; format testIDs day/hour/dur/endinfo match spec.

club/[id].tsx:270-285 metaRow renders datePill using formatMatchRange(match_date, match_end_date) with color variants for past/ongoing/upcoming — verified visually on the seeded 4/4 past card ('ven. 14 août · 16h20 → 18h20' with 4/4 confirmed badge).
